entry.title: Free RMM pricing comparison worksheet
entry.summary: Compare 50-device quotes over 12 months and use the 100-endpoint hybrid example to see what happens when one option needs a retained patching tool. Replace the example figures with your actual quotes.

entry.title: RMM first endpoint not connecting? Activation troubleshooting checklist
entry.summary: If a browser or endpoint protection blocks an installer, pause and keep protections enabled. Record the warning, source, and time. Remove workspace-specific enrollment details before sharing filenames or screenshots. The same guide covers signing waits, unfinished downloads, and missing first check-ins.

entry.title: RMM trial first 24 hours plan
entry.summary: Choose a device that can prove your pilot workflow. After it checks in, test one recurring task and compare Core and Scale before checkout. The guide also links to the original-workspace billing recovery path.

entry.title: n8n RMM integration: read-only MSP workflows
entry.summary: Download an inactive n8n workflow that uses the built-in HTTP Request node to read the first 50 active critical alerts from an authorized Nizlo workspace. The guide covers credential setup, empty results, and two additional examples for the Nizlo community node.

entry.title: RMM first-endpoint pilot acceptance checklist
entry.summary: Record who signed the installer, when the first endpoint checked in, and which customer, site, and policy it received. For a PC refresh, give the service desk both asset IDs and have them verify that the replacement checks in under the intended customer, site, and policy before closing monitoring acceptance.

entry.title: MSP managed service margin calculator
entry.summary: Compare the cost of serving a first 10-device managed customer with shared tools versus a new RMM workspace. Edit the separate tools and labor inputs, check your break-even, and use the linked pilot before committing to a recurring price.

entry.title: macOS RMM pilot evaluation matrix
entry.summary: Evaluate when an encrypted Mac resumes monitoring and remote support after a restart. Record the console before unlock, time the first new check-in afterward, and test the support session separately. Includes the 24-control pilot CSV and retains the separate sleep test.

entry.title: RMM quote normalization calculator
entry.summary: Calculate recurring and contract costs in USD, EUR, or GBP and download a CSV row that matches the free comparison worksheet. Quotes shorter than 12 months keep the full-year estimate blank until the rest of the year can be priced.

entry.title: RMM and ticketing stack cost calculator: renewal payback example
